shortDescription: A whale address bought 536.93 BTC about 6 hours ago as Bitcoin's price declined, according to Lookonchain monitoring. According to ChainCatcher, the address bc1qdp has accumulated 2,460 BTC over the past 20 days at an average purchase price of $78,966.
